scope: bounded explicit discrete constant-acceleration trajectory and independent closed-form differential numerical checks; no arbitrary physics/HPC claim; actual monotonic timer release and asynchronous native RCL process with source-owned sampled-deadline publication, cancellation/exit observation and failure settlement; local soft realtime, no hard OS interrupt/timing guarantee or external effects

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: actual monotonic timers and asynchronous native process exit
RCL-owned admission/publication and full independent controller replay
release wait, bounded backpressure, past-deadline/time-reversal/source-authority rejection, native timeout/cancel and healthy recovery
authorityProfile: RCL conditional warrants own local sampled-deadline publication; Node transports clock observations, stops owned processes and waits for real exit; no hard realtime/OS interruption guarantee

trials.intent: Each explicit step advances position by the old velocity, then adds acceleration to velocity, and appends the new position to the trajectory.
The closed-form position must match explicit integration where position is advanced with old velocity before acceleration changes that velocity.
The final velocity after a given number of constant-acceleration discrete steps must match the explicit step integrator, including zero steps.
